## About this project {.unnumbered}

This project is an independent study of *An Introduction to Statistical
Learning with Applications in Python* [@james2023].

The objective is not to reproduce the textbook chapter by chapter. Instead,
the project develops three complementary skills:

- Explaining statistical methods precisely
- Implementing their essential mechanics in Python from scratch using `NumPy`
- Testing when the methods work, fail, or produce misleading conclusions

Each chapter combines intuition, mathematical formulation, implementation,
experimentation, diagnostics, and practical limitations.

::: {.callout-note}
## Project status

This is an active learning project. Completed chapters are reproducible;
planned chapters and extensions are identified in the roadmap below.
:::

::: {.callout-important}
## Independent educational project

This repository is not affiliated with or endorsed by the textbook's authors
or publisher. Explanations, implementations, experiments, and conclusions are
my own. The textbook should be consulted for the authoritative treatment.
:::
